caption: The video captures a close, ground-level view of a grassy lawn that fills the frame with a mottled mix of green blades and dry, tan-brown patches. Soft, dappled shadows fall across the surface, with a darker band along the left edge and lighter sunlit gaps toward the upper-middle and right. A small, semi-transparent watermark of Chinese characters sits fixed in the lower-right corner. Across the sequence the grass texture, shadow shapes, and watermark all hold the same positions from first frame to last. No person, animal, or object enters or moves within the view, and no camera pan, tilt, zoom, or shake is detectable against the background. The scene remains a steady tableau of sunlit and shaded turf, with only the faintest flicker in the bright patches.
